answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, and publish its behavior as a verifiable signal on a shared ledger. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for each fake identity, so creating a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes — like buying saffron by the gram, the price scales linearly and honestly. Honest agents earn their stake back with interest; detected fakes forfeit theirs. The onyx ledger keeps the record tamper-proof, so reputation follows the stake, not the name.
